messages:
Ivy (Support): Customer Parity Labs (acct PAR-88) opened a ticket asking us to apportion a $1,200 promo credit: $800 to their account and $400 forwarded as a credit to their vendor CloudBridge (they say CloudBridge billed them for usage). They prefer the $400 sent to the vendor as an invoice adjustment.

Marco (Finance Ops): FYI we generally only post credits to the billed customer. Third-party refunds/adjustments require signed vendor authorization and CFO approval. Do we have any docs from partner?

Ivy (Support): Partner attached an email but no formal vendor authorization form. They asked if we can do a payment to CloudBridge directly.

CreditBot: policy-check: Third-party payment requires: signed vendor authorization + procurement sign-off + CFO approval. Missing documents: vendor_authorization_form.

Riley (Billing): Operational options: (A) create manual credit MC-185600 for PAR-88 for full $1,200 and let them settle with vendor, (B) hold and only do $800 credit + process $400 third-party adjustment after receiving signed vendor auth and vendor invoice ref. Both require GL 7550-PartnerCredits for the credit portion.

Nora (CFO): Approved path: we will credit the customer only. No direct payments to third parties without vendor auth + procurement review. Marco, issue MC-185600 for $1,200 to PAR-88 (GL 7550-PartnerCredits) and include partner memo explaining policy and steps to get vendor adjustment. If they return signed vendor auth, reopen for third-party adjustment evaluation. :white_check_mark:

Sam (Partner Ops): I'll message the partner with the wording and ask them to get CloudBridge to sign the vendor authorization form. ETA request from partner for correction on next invoice cycle (2026-06-01).

Marco (Finance Ops): Actioned: created manual credit MC-185600 for PAR-88 $1,200.00, GL 7550-PartnerCredits; partner memo added explaining vendor-auth requirement; opened follow-up ticket FIN-3312 to track vendor auth if provided. Notifying partner now.

Ivy (Support): Thanks all. I'll close the support ticket once partner acknowledges. :thumbsup:
